title: Our AI "Crash Sentinel" got its first real test. It works great!
author: _foursix_
selftext: Among the many experiments with AI agentic trading, we have had a crash sentinel on guard to warn of potential crashes. A couple of days ago it alerted us. I posted it to our discord, pulled the live money positions, stopped the AI, and then sat and waited. Many, many people get tempted when stocks get "cheap" like this, and they want to nibble, or play the hero, drawing comparisons, even AI research, to justify entry timing. But we sat out. The pre-market gap up fooled even the Melli AI, but this is where multiple agentic AI comes into play, each serving different roles. So far AI is proving to keep trading disciplined, and good at protecting your capital, even if it can't make one rich yet.
